notes: *made way for her* divides with *made* on the verb and *way* on יָדַיִם: the ASV spends an English word on each morpheme, so rule 2 splits the idiom rather than fusing it under rule 30.

*the horse gate* renders the rectum attributively (rule 28); a present article morpheme takes the written *the* standing before its own word, so it goes to the article on הַסּוּסִים, while the outer construct מְבוֹא takes the supplied *the* of a multi-level chain (rule 29).
